docs.summary: Maps a detected [`ImageFormat`](#api~Prowl.Aperture.ImageFormat) to the decoder that handles it. Pre-populated with every built in decoder; [`Register`](#api~Prowl.Aperture.ImageDecoderRegistry~Register) replaces one or adds a format of your own.
Every format that currently has a decoder.
Installs a decoder, replacing any existing one for the same format.
Removes the decoder for a format, so loads of it fail with [`NotSupported`](#api~Prowl.Aperture.ApertureError~NotSupported).
